pairs.registryProposal: The standard's row-mapping technique treats model-derived select lists and positional decoding as a binary choice, but tracklight demonstrates an intermediate state where SelectList derives column order from schema for statement generation while row decoding remains manual positional decoding (e.g. in jobs.rs). Explicit guidance on migrating from manual positional decoding to fully derived mappers without regressions would improve actionable adoption.
